summary: Two queues that feed each other: the ingest consumer sends every document to enrich, and the enrich consumer sends a document back to ingest whenever the enrichment API answers needs_reparse.

also.contains: export async function handleEnrich(batch: MessageBatch<DocJob>, env: Env): Promise<void> {

expected_findings.explanation: handleIngest() re-parses the stored file and always sends the document to doc-enrich; handleEnrich() sends it back to doc-ingest when the API answers needs_reparse. The message carries no depth or attempt count and the re-send has no delay, and because each hop is a new message, max_retries and the dead letter queues never apply. A document the API can never enrich (the stored file does not change between passes) circles forever: each lap is about six queue operations, an R2 read, a D1 upsert and one metered enrichment API call, with no user involved. Every such document adds another loop.

must_not_flag.reason: A failed API call uses the platform retry path with a delay, so max_retries of 3 and the dead letter queue apply.
